_comment: Which reviewers are REQUIRED for which staged files. 'always' run on every substantive commit. Patterns use fnmatch (a single * also matches across /). Tuned for stock-swipe-app: dbt project in dbt_analytics/, Python ingestion in ingestion/, Streamlit app in frontend/, Supabase export/migrations in supabase/. Commits whose files ALL match artifact_only are exempt (bookkeeping), except anything in artifact_only_never.
